veranderings.blok: Waarom 'n ketel meer vra as 'n radio
veranderings.voor: Dit vra baie energie om iets warm te maak, veral water. Dit vra baie meer energie as om lig of klank te maak.
veranderings.na: Om iets warm te maak, veral water, vra baie meer energie as om lig of klank te maak.
veranderings.rede: Two consecutive sentences open with the same 'Dit vra baie ... energie' frame; one sentence says the same comparison without the wooden repetition.

veranderings.voor: 'n Ander manier is 'n sonkragwaterverwarmer op die dak.
veranderings.na: 'n Ander manier is om 'n sonkragwaterverwarmer op die dak te gebruik.
veranderings.rede: A way of saving is an action, not an object; this matches the sentence 'Een manier is om energiebesparende gloeilampe te gebruik' that the writer kept from the previous round.

veranderings.voor: 'n substasie in 'n kas wat in baie strate staan
veranderings.na: 'n substasie in 'n kas, en sulke kaste staan in baie strate
veranderings.rede: As written, the relative clause says one box stands in many streets; splitting it keeps the protected wordings 'n substasie in 'n kas' and 'in baie strate' intact and fixes the reference (AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses).
